data.description:
## Goal

Add a pure, framework-free DLC gate helper that any game uses to gate content on the unified unlock state, and prove it end-to-end with a Gym scene whose content is unreachable until the action is verified. Proof target: Gym scene only (producer decision); per-game roll-out is follow-up work.

## Acceptance Criteria

- A pure helper (`src/core-engine/DlcGate.ts` or equivalent) gates content on `isUnlocked({ kind: 'dlc', gameId, dlcId })`.
- An unknown, unreadable, or absent unlock state degrades to "not unlocked" and never crashes the owning game.
- `example-games/gym/scenes/GymDlcUnlockScene.ts` demonstrates a DLC content item that is locked until verified, then reachable, with a documented locked-state presentation.
- A unit test covers the gate helper; a browser/Gym test covers the gated-content UI (locked → verified → reachable); tests pass under their projects.

## Minimal Implementation

- New pure `src/core-engine/DlcGate.ts` (no Phaser/Electron dependency; takes an unlock-check function).
- New Gym scene using SLL and the existing Gym scene base, consuming the F5 read client.
- Locked-state presentation documented in the scene help text.

## Key Files

- `src/core-engine/DlcGate.ts` — **new**: pure DLC unlock gate.
- `example-games/gym/scenes/GymDlcUnlockScene.ts` — **new**: proof scene.
- `tests/core-engine/DlcGate.test.ts` — **new**.
- `tests/gym/GymDlcUnlock.browser.test.ts` — **new**.

## Deliverables

Gate helper + Gym proof scene + unit/browser tests.

## Dependencies

- Generalised IPC/preload bridge and total read API (F5).

## Test Plan

`npx vitest run --project unit tests/core-engine/DlcGate.test.ts` and `npx vitest run --project browser tests/gym/GymDlcUnlock.browser.test.ts`
